external_benchmarks.reason: No legally usable independent dataset with a trustworthy expected result is available in the repository. M22 does not acquire or fabricate reference results to change this status.
required_evidence: frozen preprocessing, mesh, inversion, stopping, metric, and tolerance protocol

limitations: Internal synthetic evidence is not independent validation.
The internal fixture is small; no medium, large, or stress-scale convergence behaviour is measured.
Residual reduction, stability, and reproducibility do not establish geological correctness or uniqueness.
No uncertainty, resolution, or topography-aware inversion result is produced.

The engines separate invalid input from numerical failure by exception class (``ERT2DError`` / ``ERT3DError`` / ``VESError`` for rejected input, ``ERT2DNumericalError`` / ``ERT3DNumericalError`` / ``VESNumericalError`` for a mid-run forward-model or solver failure) and by the recorded failure phase. A numerical failure that is raised as a bare ``ValueError`` by a future library version would still be recorded as ``INVALID_INPUT``; no such case is reachable in the committed studies.
Reaching a configured limit is retained as bounded-completion evidence and is never reported as a defect.
M15 physical LS2 validation remains pending and the ABEM/Barugo importer remains NOT_READY.

log10_rmse.does_not_establish: That a smaller log10 residual means a more accurate model.
log10_rmse.measures: Root-mean-square difference in log10 response, the space the engines fit.
log10_rmse.requires: Two equal-length finite positive response sequences.

max_absolute_difference.does_not_establish: Where or why a difference matters geologically.
max_absolute_difference.measures: Largest absolute response difference in the compared sequences.

model_l2_difference.does_not_establish: Model correctness; different discretizations are not comparable this way.
model_l2_difference.measures: Euclidean distance between two log10 model parameter vectors.
model_l2_difference.requires: Two equal-length finite model vectors *and* an identical declared discretization (mesh edges, so cell locations and volumes match, plus the same parameter order). Cases whose discretizations differ are omitted instead of compared.

model_relative_l2_difference.does_not_establish: Uniqueness or resolution of the inverted model.
model_relative_l2_difference.measures: Model L2 difference normalized by the baseline model-vector norm.
model_relative_l2_difference.requires: Two equal-length finite non-zero model vectors and the same discretization/parameter identity as ``model_l2_difference``.

relative_rmse.does_not_establish: Any statement about which configuration is scientifically preferable.
relative_rmse.measures: Root-mean-square of the response difference normalized by the baseline magnitude.
relative_rmse.requires: Two equal-length finite response sequences with non-zero baseline values.

rmse.does_not_establish: Geological accuracy, uniqueness, resolution, or field validity.
rmse.measures: Root-mean-square difference between a compared response and the baseline response.
rmse.requires: Two equal-length finite response sequences with identical observation order.

superseded_artifacts.historical_evidence_retained: The superseded v1 values are not overwritten silently: the pre-correction 3D reporting values are retained in the `corrections` block of docs/m21_scientific_qualification.json, the pre-correction VES and nonuniform-mesh values are recorded in docs/m23_forward_physics_correction.md and the M23 evidence notes, and the changelog records the transition.
superseded_artifacts.reason: The M23 audit-corrected forward physics changed the numbers this artifact records. The A1 VES layered-earth kernel correction changes every VES objective, trajectory, and model; the A2/A3 nonuniform-mesh transmissibility corrections change every 2D and 3D nonuniform-mesh forward response; and the B1-B4 integrity corrections change the recorded failure phases, the admission rules, the model-comparison discretization requirement, and the VES input-failure behaviour. The v1 records were produced by the pre-correction implementation.

unavailable_evidence.reason: The VES engine exposes no damping control; no variant is simulated.
A 1D layered-earth model has no mesh or domain resolution to vary.
scipy.optimize.least_squares exposes no per-evaluation objective series; M22 records the initial and final objective but refuses to invent a trajectory.
Only accepted/attempted step objectives and the returned model evaluation are exposed; internal line-search and Jacobian evaluations are not recorded.
Only solver step objectives and the returned model evaluation are exposed; internal Jacobian evaluations are not recorded.
Not implemented; out of M22 scope.
No authorized independent dataset with a trustworthy reference result is available.

unvalidated_claims: A lower residual, a decreasing trajectory, or a nominal convergence criterion does not establish a more accurate geological model.
Stable repeat results do not establish field accuracy or instrument validity.
Reproducibility does not establish correctness or agreement with an external reference.
Bounded completion at a configured limit is not evidence of an implementation defect.
No RES2DINV, commercial-solver, or published-dataset equivalence is claimed.
No uncertainty, resolution, or inversion-uniqueness result is provided.
